title: Add revocation and advisory metadata model
purpose: Represent revoked artifacts, publisher keys and vulnerability advisories in local registry snapshots.
scope: Bind advisories to artifact coordinates and digests.
Define active-artifact degraded projection when revoked content is present.
acceptance_criteria: Existing active revoked artifact is flagged degraded.
Advisory metadata is included in support/provenance projections.
failure_modes: Advisory is not bound to digest.
